title: Sand Table
description: A zen garden of fine sand in a walnut tray under low evening light. Drag to rake grooves that pile into ridges and cast real shadows; rake the same ground again and you dig, until a record cover printed on a buried tile surfaces.
intent: One material finished to the edge: a GPU height field of dry sand that holds every groove at its angle of repose, lit so low that each ridge throws a shadow, with an album buried underneath for the hand to find.
